title: Select Sector indices — conditional quarter-end secondary reweighting (24%/4.8%/50% breach test)
source: EST: rule-derived, not a scheduled publication. SEC EDGAR, Select Sector SPDR Trust Form 497, accession 0001193125-26-031948, document d85739d497.htm, re-fetched direct 2026-09-06 by this initial-research session (HTTP 200, 2,388,335 bytes) and re-parsed from the raw HTML rather than inherited. Verbatim: "Additionally, if, on the second to last business day of March, June, September, or December a company has a weight greater than 24% or the sum of the companies with weights greater than 4.8% exceeds 50%, a secondary reweighting will be triggered with the reweighting effective date being after the close of the last business day of the month." June 2027's last business day is Wednesday 2027-06-30 and the second-to-last is Tuesday 2027-06-29, computed mechanically this session against the NYSE 2027 closure list (nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes, fetched direct 2026-09-06), which lists exactly one June 2027 closure: "Friday, June 18 (Juneteenth National Independence Day observed)". So the test is 06-29 and the trade, IF triggered, clears at the 06-30 close. Filed estimate because the trigger is CONDITIONAL -- most quarters it does not fire, and no primary source can pre-confirm that it will. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by this event's own never-assessed initial research (2026-09-06), which found the id existed only as proposals/sp-select-sector-secondary-reweight-2027-06-30.from-fomc-minutes-2027-06-30.json; that proposal was read in full first and its findings are carried forward, not discarded. A BACKSTOP, not a base case -- the June 2027 analogue of the 2026-09-30 and 2027-03-31 entries. WHAT IS SPECIFIC TO JUNE, measured this session rather than inherited: (1) June is the only quarter of the four whose PRIMARY rebalance runway is FOUR sessions instead of five, because Juneteenth 2027-06-18 pulls the effective close back to Thursday 2027-06-17; its drift window from that reset to the 06-29 test stays at the normal seven, so June's holiday hits the opposite half of the mechanic from March's Good Friday (which leaves the runway at five and cuts the drift window to six). (2) That prior-business-day displacement was ASSUMED by two sibling entries and is now measured: June 2026 was the identical collision (2026-06-19 was both Juneteenth and June's third Friday, closed per nyse.com's own 2026 column), and back-solving AMZN's XLY weight from the 2026-09-03 issuer file lands 22.90% on Thursday 2026-06-18 against the filing's own 23.00% step-1 target, versus 22.19% on Monday 2026-06-22 -- the prior day fits 8x better. (3) The corridor is the loudest of the four quarters, not the quietest: consumer-confidence-2027-06-29 (medium) sits ON the test date, fomc-minutes-2027-06-30 (medium) ON the effective close, and FTSE Russell's June reconstitution implements at the 2027-06-25 close, inside the drift window and two sessions before the test -- proposed this session as proposals/russell-reconstitution-2027-06-25.from-sp-select-sector-secondary-reweight-2027-06-30.json. (4) Measured against that: the Russell-containing June drift window is NOT hotter for the one live single-name path -- 1 of the 10 actual June windows 2017-2026 cleared the +4.35% AMZN-relative move, 10.0% against a 10.3% unconditional seven-session rate. Honest caveats re-stated rather than laundered: issuer holdings weights are capped index weights drifted by price plus a cash residual, so every cohort sum is a floor on the float-adjusted index weights the test actually applies to. Low impact and estimate status: it widens caution about the 2027-06-29 and 2027-06-30 closes and licenses nothing, and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4/G1) is index-flow-keyed (re-grepped 2026-09-06, zero hits). Kind `sector` is the closest fit the enum offers for a market-structure flow event; the imperfect fit is named, not fixed from this lane.
